blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Many may be irritated with the demeanor of the witnesses presented by Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers as they appear to be evasive, but public prosecutor and Bicol Saro party-list Rep. Terry Ridon understands why they had to do that — as jobs and lives are at stake back home. In a press briefing on Tuesday after the 40th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, Ridon was asked if the prosecution saw a pattern as two of the three witness they were complaining about — for supposedly lying and being evasive — are both officials from Davao City, which […]...
